title: 棒人間の毎日
lead: 朝の支度から就寝まで、日常のひとこまを棒人間で12点描きました。資料や説明図にそのまま差し込めるシンプルな素材です。
subject_en: the SAME friendly stick figure in daily life: a round head in warm cream (#FFF6E0, never pure white) with a closed black outline, dot eyes and a simple mouth, body and limbs as thick uniform black lines, a single orange scarf as the only accent colour; props are drawn with the same thick black line and may use the same orange. Each item is a small scene with one figure. Each item is a separate small subject centred in its cell with space around, never touching another. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates, clouds) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
items: stretching both arms up next to a small bed
brushing teeth at a small sink
eating at a small table with a bowl and a cup
walking with a bag toward the right
standing and holding a strap in a train car
stirring a pot on a stove
hanging a shirt on a laundry line
sitting in a bathtub with only the head and shoulders visible
lying in bed under a blanket
